sum: Waaree Energies Limited has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a substantial acquisition announcement in solar manufacturer Indosolar Limited. The filing marks the formal public disclosure phase of the transaction under the takeover regulations.
detail: Waaree Energies Limited, a renewable energy player, has disclosed a substantial acquisition in Indosolar Limited under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure was filed with NSE on or around 30 June 2026. Under the Takeover Code, this disclosure mandates a public offer (either open or conditional) within 4 weeks, and imposes strict adherence to pricing, timing and disclosure rules. No offer price, shareholding data, or deal value has yet been disclosed in publicly available sources.
